name: opendexter
description: Give Codex a governed Dexter Wallet for x402 purchases and bounded Send, Buy, and Sell.

interface.shortDescription: Governed payments and asset actions inside Codex.
interface.longDescription:
OpenDexter connects Codex to the user's passkey-controlled Dexter Wallet. It discovers services, creates API-custodied purchase intents, reads the wallet and approved portfolio bound to the authenticated session, and executes only exact purchases or governed Send, Buy, and Sell requests covered by the user's reusable bounded authority.

The hosted 0.5.0 contract exposes five anonymous entry tools and promotes seven more after native OAuth, for exactly twelve connected tools. Assets are selected only by a canonical assetId from the server-approved portfolio. Owner enrollment, mandate extension, and escalation remain outside model-callable tools. There are no hidden compatibility, card, passkey-status, marketplace-composition, or authorize tools.

Wallet keys, passkey material, bearer tokens, signing material, and one-time codes never belong in the conversation. Ambiguous or post-dispatch results are inspected on the same intent and never retried automatically.
defaultPrompt: Find an x402 API for this job and show me its current terms.
Show my OpenDexter wallet and governed portfolio.
Prepare a governed asset action covered by my current mandate.
